course.title: Unit 4 Helping in the community--Lesson A-【例句】
course.description: Unit 4 Helping in the community--Lesson A-【例句】

sentences.content: Our neighbour is a firefighter. He often helps people.
sentences.english: Our neighbour is a firefighter . He often helps people
sentences.chinese: 我们的邻居是一名消防员。他经常帮助人们。

wordDetails.definition: help（第三人称单数）: 帮助

sentences.content: Yes, he's a very nice man.
sentences.english: Yes , he's a very nice man
sentences.chinese: 是的，他是个非常好的人。

sentences.content: Liu Jia's father is also very nice.
sentences.english: Liu Jia's father is also very nice
sentences.chinese: Liu Jia的父亲也非常友善。

sentences.content: He's a school bus driver. He takes us to school every day.
sentences.english: He's a school bus driver . He takes us to school every day
sentences.chinese: 他是一名校车司机，每天接送我们上下学。

wordDetails.definition: take（第三人称单数现在时）: 带

sentences.content: My neighbour is a police officer. She helps a lot of people.
sentences.english: My neighbour is a police officer . She helps a lot of people
sentences.chinese: 我的邻居是一名警察。她帮助了很多人。

wordDetails.definition: help（第三人称单数）: 帮助

sentences.content: What do people do, To help the community?
sentences.english: What do people do , To help the community ?
sentences.chinese: 人们做些什么来帮助社区？

sentences.content: Some wash the windows. Some help others cross the street.
sentences.english: Some wash the windows . Some help others cross the street
sentences.chinese: 有人擦窗户，有人帮助他人过马路。

sentences.content: What can you do, To help your community?
sentences.english: What can you do , To help your community ?
sentences.chinese: 你能做些什么来帮助你的社区？

sentences.content: I can sing for old people, Or tell stories for kids!
sentences.english: I can sing for old people , Or tell stories for kids !
sentences.chinese: 我可以为老人们唱歌，或者给孩子们讲故事！

wordDetails.definition: have（第三人称单数现在时）: 有

sentences.content: He takes photos with his phone.
sentences.english: He takes photos with his phone

wordDetails.definition: take（第三人称单数）: 拍摄

sentences.content: This is a photo of some elephants.
sentences.english: This is a photo of some elephants

sentences.content: It's a photo from his phone!
sentences.english: It's a photo from his phone !
